history.title: Our History
history.subtitle: Ministry Eternal Life in Honduras
history.paragraph1: God gave the vision to missionaries Víctor Solórzano and Doris Hernández to found Ministry Eternal Life in Honduras.
history.paragraph2: After a visit as volunteers with their son Javier, they saw the healthcare needs and extreme poverty in the region, and God's goodness motivated them to start with children bringing medical brigades along with the transforming message of Jesus Christ.
history.paragraph3: With that purpose, missionaries Fernando and Glenni arrived, answering the call to give life to the mission and preparing a youth team of missionaries who will carry the salvation message to the next generation.
history.gallerySubtitle: Moments of worship, fellowship, and Biblical study
history.purposeText: Our fundamental purpose is to equip churches, youth, teachers, and families to be effective in fulfilling the Great Commission.
history.missionText: Preach the good news (the gospel of Jesus Christ). Reach the lost and present them the salvation plan that is given in the name of Jesus Christ. Build up the church, strengthening them in love for God and biblical knowledge.
history.visionText: Having incorporated the practice of developing ourselves through a good biblical base, we seek the development of members who exercise in their secular and spiritual life honesty, integrity, and holiness.
